extDescription.message: Navigate the web using only head and eye movements. An accessibility tool.

popupCameraHint.message: If the camera is blocked, click "Setup" and allow it, then start again.

popupVoiceUnavailable.message: unavailable, start HeadNav and try again

popupMicHint.message: If the microphone is blocked, click "Setup" and allow it, then test again.

popupLocalVoiceHint.message: Local voice is not installed. Click "Setup" to install it or to choose online.

errorFramesStalled.message: No camera frames are being processed. Try stopping and starting again.

setupIntro.message: Someone can help with this page once. After that, HeadNav is used hands-free.

setupCameraText.message: HeadNav needs your camera to read head and eye movements. All processing happens locally in your browser — no video ever leaves your machine.

setupMicrophoneText.message: Used only for voice dictation, and only while you dictate.

setupOnlineText.message: Usually more accurate, works in more languages, needs no download and works on any computer with Chrome. Needs internet, and Chrome sends your audio to Google to turn it into text.

setupLocalText.message: Your audio never leaves this computer, even without internet. Needs a one-time download of the language package, may be less accurate, uses this computer's processor and only works in recent Chrome versions and some languages.

setupPermissionDenied.message: blocked. Allow it in Chrome's site settings for this extension

setupCameraGrantedHint.message: You can close this tab and start HeadNav from the toolbar.

setupMicrophoneGrantedHint.message: Voice dictation can be used while HeadNav is on.

setupLocalVoiceUnavailable.message: not available for this language in this Chrome

setupLocalVoiceUnsupported.message: not supported by this Chrome version
